title: Government-published propaganda books as a cover-up campaign

tellings.quote: and you're going to find all sorts of books on the shelves with lots of truth. But right next to them are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.

plain: The US government secretly publishes books full of propaganda and places them on shelves next to books that hold real truth about UFOs, as part of what was called "a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth." The writer Brent Friedman says this was told to him directly by John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. If true, it would mean much of the popular UFO literature was planted on purpose to confuse the public.
